subject: Action: Align invoice remittance and PO entity for upcoming capacity burst
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avalontech.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: treasury@avalontech.com
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated PO + remit change for Q1 capacity burst

Hi Aditya,

We're planning a capacity top-up tied to our Q1 product launch (estimated +120% of current committed throughput). To simplify payments across the different business units, Treasury wants to consolidate invoices under a single PO and route remittance to our centralized payor: AvalonTech Treasury (EIN on file).

Ask: Can Redwood accept a consolidated PO that covers the upcoming renewal and the burst capacity, and shift invoice remit to the centralized billing entity (AvalonTech Treasury)? Treasury is also requesting a one-off term change to net60 for this settlement cycle while they update internal payment cadence.

I'll attach the PO request template for your review. We'll also submit the signed PO and a W-9 if needed by early next week. Please confirm next steps and whether you need any legal amendment or DocuSign to reflect the net60 request.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Treasury, AvalonTech
samir.patel@avalontech.com

Attachment: AvalonTech_PO_Request_2027.pdf

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avalontech.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 Jan 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated PO + remit change for Q1 capacity burst

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the PO template. We're excited to support the Q1 burst. Quick notes / next steps: 

- Consolidated PO: yes, we can accept a single PO that covers the renewal + capacity top-up. Please send the signed PO when ready (PDF).
- Remittance: we'll route invoices to AvalonTech Treasury. Can you confirm the remit address and the preferred payment method (EFT/ACH or wire)?
- Net terms: we can propose a one-time change to net60 for this settlement. Legal will need an amendment to the master subscription to reflect the temporary term exception; I've attached a short amendment draft we typically use. If that looks fine, we can send via DocuSign for signature.
- Tax forms: please attach the W-9 for the billing entity (if US) or W-8/W-9 mix if multi-entity.

Internal CC: Jordan, Kimberly, Marissa — can you confirm (1) acceptance of net60 as a one-time accommodation, (2) if finance needs any additional treasury details to enable EFT, and (3) whether consolidated PO mapping to our billing entity requires any special ledger treatment?

Samir — once we have the signed PO and W-9, we'll generate the amendment and send a DocuSign link with the revised invoicing instructions. ETA: if you send docs by Tues, Jan 5, we can target the first consolidated invoice in the Jan 31 cycle.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Redwood_Amendment_Draft.pdf

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 03 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Consolidated PO + remit change for Q1 capacity burst — finance intake

Marissa / Kimberly — forwarding the ask from Avalon (Samir). Key points: consolidated PO covering renewal + burst, remit to AvalonTech Treasury, one-off request for net60.

Internal guidance I'm proposing:
- Approve net60 as a one-time exception tied to this renewal (we should mark as conditional on receiving signed PO + W-9).
- Finance needs Treasury EFT details (bank name, routing, account). Ask Aditya: will Avalon provide automated ACH details or do they prefer manual wires?
- For accounting: map consolidated PO to single billing code but tag line items for the renewal vs burst capacity to keep usage reporting intact.

Can you confirm whether we require an AR holdback or credit hold for the first cycle? Also advise if the amendment draft (attached) needs material changes on your side before I send the DocuSign link to Samir.

Thanks — please reply with approvals or redlines.

On Tue, Jan 02, 2027 at 10:07 AM aditya_rao@redwood.com wrote:
> Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the PO template...
> (see above)

- Aditya

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@avalontech.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: treasury@avalontech.com
Date: Mon, 04 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated PO + remit change for Q1 capacity burst

Aditya — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming Treasury will: 

- Send the consolidated PO (covers renewal + Q1 burst) by EOD Jan 4. See attached PO stub; the signed PDF will follow from procurement separately.
- Attach company W-9 for the billing entity (W9_AvalonTech.pdf).
- Provide ACH/EFT details in the PO cover email; Treasury prefers ACH for recurring invoices.

We agree to the conditional net60 one-time term exception — procurement asked us to document it in an amendment; please proceed with the DocuSign link and we'll route internally.

Samir Patel
Head of Treasury, AvalonTech
samir.patel@avalontech.com

Attachment: AvalonTech_PO_Consolidated_Stub.pdf, W9_AvalonTech.pdf
